$comment: THE ONE SCHEMA TABLE for configuration.toml, and the single source of truth for three consumers in scripts/generate.mjs: the unknown-key check, the defaults masker, and the validator. None of those three carries its own key list -- a second list is a second thing to forget to update, and the failure mode is a key that validates against one list while being rejected by another. `required: true` IS the mask list (D-06): a required setting is one a downstream manifest must state for itself and can never silently inherit from this project's defaults layer, because inheriting it would mean shipping this project's identity under someone else's name. Keys are dotted paths; an element of an array of tables is addressed with an empty-bracket segment, for example `variants[].id`. WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT: configuration.toml is NOT an expectation source for scripts/verify-branding-preflight.mjs. That gate reads its expected values from inventory/brand-tokens.json's hand-authored brand_display_expectations block and must continue to. If the preflight ever read the manifest that the generator also writes from, it would be comparing one pass's output against the same pass's input and would agree with itself no matter how wrong both were.

product.vendor_machine.regex_help: the machine vendor becomes part of the profile directory path, so it may contain no space and no slash; letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit

product.vendor_display.regex_help: letters, digits, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only; 1 to 64 characters; must start with a letter or digit

identity.display_name.regex_help: letters, digits, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only; 1 to 64 characters; must start with a letter or digit

identity.app_basename.regex_help: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; 2 to 32 characters; must start with a letter

identity.binary_name.regex_help: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; 2 to 32 characters; must start with a letter

identity.remoting_name.regex_help: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; 2 to 32 characters; must start with a letter

identity.distribution_id.regex_help: lowercase reverse-domain form, for example org.example

legal.copyright_holder.regex_help: letters, digits, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only; 1 to 64 characters; must start with a letter or digit

legal.trademark_notice.regex_help: letters, digits, spaces, commas, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only; 1 to 192 characters; must start with a letter or digit
legal.trademark_notice.regex_example: Acme Browser is a trademark of Acme Works.

theia.welcome_text.regex_help: plain words with no markup or code: letters, digits, spaces and ordinary punctuation, but no angle bracket, ampersand, double quote, backtick, dollar sign, backslash or control character
theia.welcome_text.regex_example: A browser you can make your own.

theia.about_text.regex_help: plain words with no markup or code: letters, digits, spaces and ordinary punctuation, but no angle bracket, ampersand, double quote, backtick, dollar sign, backslash or control character

urls.release_notes.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

urls.update.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

urls.crash_report.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

urls.homepage.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

urls.search.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

installer.support_url.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

installer.tile_color.regex_help: a hash sign followed by exactly six hexadecimal digits, 0 to 9 and a to f

telemetry.endpoint.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

upstreams.firefox_esr_tag.regex_help: a plain upstream tag name, never a glob or pattern; letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only

variants[].id.regex_help: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; 1 to 32 characters; must start with a letter

variants[].name_suffix.regex_help: empty, or letters, digits, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only; at most 31 characters. The release variant's suffix is deliberately empty, so the empty string is allowed here and nowhere else

variants[].branding_dir.regex_help: a folder path inside the project, written relative to it, with no leading slash and no '..' step; letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens and slashes only

variants[].objdir.regex_help: a folder path inside the project, written relative to it, with no leading slash and no '..' step; letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens and slashes only

extensions[].id.regex_help: a namespaced extension id: the publisher, a dot, then the extension name; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens in the publisher, dots also allowed in the name

extensions[].version.regex_help: an exact pinned version, never a range or a floating tag; letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit

extensions[].url.regex_help: a web address starting with https:// and containing no spaces or control characters

extensions[].sha256.regex_help: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, the sha256 of the extension archive bytes
